headline.en: UNI holds $9 but burns 2.6M tokens against 20M emissions—net inflation +1.96%/year persists despite fee switch
headline.zh: UNI守住9美元但年化销毁260万枚对阵2000万增发—尽管费用开关启动，净通胀率仍为+1.96%

keyChanges.en: Net inflation remains positive at 17.4M UNI/year (+1.96%) as 2.6M token burns cannot offset 20M annual emissions at current $9 price
keyChanges.zh: 净通胀保持正值，为每年1740万枚UNI(+1.96%)，因按当前9美元价格年化销毁260万枚无法抵消2000万年度增发

keyChanges.en: Price at $9.01 trades 51% premium to treasury's $5.96 fair value anchor from 100M UNI burn, suggesting either fee expansion front-running or misvaluation
keyChanges.zh: 当前9.01美元价格较国库1亿枚UNI销毁时5.96美元公允价值锚定溢价51%，暗示市场要么在抢跑手续费扩展预期，要么存在错误定价

keyChanges.en: Fee expansion proposals (Arc, Robinhood Chain) in temp check phase could materially increase $138M annualized revenue base and compress inflation
keyChanges.zh: 手续费扩展提案(Arc、Robinhood链)处于温度检查阶段，可能实质性提升1.38亿美元年化收入基数并压缩通胀率

contrarianObservation.en: $9 isn't expensive if fee expansions execute—Arc + Robinhood could 2-3x revenue to $300M+ annualized within 6 months, increasing buyback budget to $51M/year and burning 5.67M UNI annually, cutting net inflation to 1.43%. Market may be correctly front-running this trackable governance pipeline rather than overpaying.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若手续费扩展落地，9美元并不贵—Arc+Robinhood可能在6个月内使收入翻2-3倍至年化3亿美元以上，回购预算增至每年5100万美元，年化销毁567万枚UNI，将净通胀率降至1.43%。市场或许在正确抢跑这条可追踪的治理管线，而非盲目溢价。

watchNext.en: Fee expansion vote outcomes (Arc, Robinhood) - passage directly increases buyback budget and reduces net inflation trajectory
watchNext.zh: 手续费扩展提案投票结果(Arc、Robinhood)—通过将直接增加回购预算并降低净通胀趋势

watchNext.en: Real-yield staking proposal emergence - would fundamentally shift valuation from governance token (PE multiple) to cash-flow asset (DCF)
watchNext.zh: 实际收益质押提案出现—将从根本上改变估值框架，从治理代币(PE倍数法)转向现金流资产(DCF法)

watchNext.en: Price vs net inflation dynamics - rising price worsens inflation at fixed revenue; falling price improves inflation but crushes market cap (reflexive trap)
watchNext.zh: 价格与净通胀动态—收入不变时价格上涨恶化通胀；价格下跌改善通胀但重挫市值(反身性陷阱)

fullReasoning.en: UNI holds $9 despite ongoing dilution: $138M annual revenue funds $23.5M buybacks, burning 2.6M tokens against 20M fixed emissions—net inflation +1.96%/year. Price sits 51% above treasury's $5.96 burn anchor, implying market expects revenue growth or misvaluation. Fee expansion proposals (Arc, Robinhood) could double revenue and compress inflation materially if passed. But low volume ($35M), retail-long positioning (1.81 ratio), and 58% BTC dominance pressure alts. Without real-yield staking proposal (not yet formal), UNI remains governance token priced for optionality not cash flow. Technical support intact but upside requires governance catalysts—fee expansions are trackable and live in temp check phase. Current valuation assumes execution; failure reverts toward $6 anchor. Risk/reward neutral pending governance resolution.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI守住9美元但结构性通胀持续：年化协议收入1.38亿美元支撑2350万美元回购预算，按当前价格年化销毁260万枚代币，但面对2000万枚固定增发，净通胀率仍为+1.96%/年。当前价格较国库5.96美元销毁锚定价溢价51%，暗示市场押注收入增长或存在错误定价。手续费扩展提案(Arc、Robinhood链)若通过可能使收入翻倍并显著压缩通胀。但成交量偏低(3500万美元)、散户多头拥挤(多空比1.81)及BTC主导率58%对山寨币构成压力。在实际收益质押提案(尚未正式提出)落地前，UNI仍是治理代币，定价反映未来期权价值而非现金流。技术支撑位维持，但上行空间取决于治理催化剂——手续费扩展提案已进入温度检查阶段且可追踪。当前估值假设提案执行成功；若失败则可能回撤至6美元锚定价。风险收益比中性，等待治理结果明朗。
